methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native represent grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, suggesting peer-to-peer knowledge transfer could enable distributed deep learning if sustained beyond individual initiatives.

signals.title: Roanoke College joins Google AI for Education Accelerator - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's participation in Google's AI Education Accelerator signals institutional commitment to building AI fluency in a non-metro region, potentially creating a regional knowledge node that could distribute capability through educator networks.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI adoption pressure on Richmond's young workforce indicates platform-driven automation spreading beyond NoVA, but 'pressure' language suggests shallow integration focused on tool usage rather than deep technical capability development.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: Youth-focused cybersecurity and AI camps at Old Dominion represent intentional capability-building in Hampton Roads' defense-adjacent economy, creating early-stage technical fluency that could compound into regional depth if connected to career pathways.

signals.title: IT Department Lays Out AI Policy for Norfolk Classrooms - govtech.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's formalized AI classroom policy signals institutional depth emerging in Hampton Roads, but centralized IT department control may limit distribution to guided implementation rather than broad experimentation across the region's educators.
